verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents bulk-launching workflows through its REST API, and it offers contract signing, so mass-dispatching a document is possible. However, the evidence shows this only as a developer-facing API pattern, not as an in-app bulk-send of one document to many signers that a legal-ops lead could run directly. Missing for 10: a no-code/in-app bulk-send feature, explicit evidence that bulk launch routes the same document to many signers, recipient-list handling and tracking details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
